name: @papercusp/drawer-stack
description: Generic cross-island coordinator for right-edge drawers that share one trigger stack and can coexist as side-by-side panes (newest opens leftmost), with a viewport-aware overlay fallback. Framework: vanilla store + a thin React hook. Owns placement, the shared backdrop, ESC + scroll-lock; it does NOT reimplement the drawer panel (Vaul/Radix stay in the consumer).
